method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Act 1992 (No. 31 of 1992), mrdoc 47938 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47938.txt; latest amendment shown No. 42 of 2024 s 58. Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Regulations 1992, version 04-h0-02 (currency from 13 Jun 2018), mrdoc 40959 retrieved 2026-10-20, deposited at ../../../rates-and-charges-rebates-and-deferments-regulations-1992/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_40959.txt (limits in rr 3(2), 4(1A), 4(2), rating years from 1 July 2018). The s 40(5)-(7) equations, images missing from the deposited text, are taken from ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47938.formulas.md, transcribed by hand on 2026-10-21 from the authorised Word rendering of mrdoc 47938. Charges in the cases are illustrative.

scope: From the seat of the pensioner or senior ratepayer, for the WA life event Jake k095: s 3(1) definitions; s 5 (seniors' card conditions a fact); ss 22, 23(1), (1a), (2), (3), (4A), (4), (5), 24, 25 (eligible pensioner and eligible senior; means test a fact; no s 24 eligibility or s 25 test prescribed); s 27(1)-(2), (5); s 28(1)(b), (2), (3); ss 29-29C (relevant interests, as one choice); s 30(1); s 32(1a), (3), (4); s 33(2), (3), (6), (7); s 35(1), (4); s 38; s 40(1), (1A), (2), (2A), (3A), (4)-(7), (9) with Regulations rr 3(2), 4(1A), 4(2); s 41; s 43; s 44(1), (2), (2A); s 45; s 46(1); s 47 (conditional); s 49. Points the Local Government Act 1995 s 6.51(4) and FES Act s 36S inputs here (`Am I entitled to a rebate or deferment`). Not encoded: ss 8-21 (administration, review, reimbursement, transitional), s 6, s 26, s 28(1)(a), (4), (5), s 30(2), s 31, s 32A, ss 36, 37, 39, s 40(3), (8), s 42, s 44(3), s 46(2)-(3), s 48, Schedule 1; rating years before 2018/19; soil and land conservation rates and charges prescribed under para (d); consumption water charges.
